summary: Full-stack regression for The Bullet Zone. Backend (4/4 pytest passing): GET /api/, POST /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings, and 422 validation. Frontend: verified Sunday-OPEN change across Contact hours, Book Service hours, footer ('Open All Days 9 AM - 11 PM'), Home hero & floating buttons. Zero occurrences of 'Closed' anywhere on the site across all 9 pages. Booking form E2E works end-to-end (POST 200, success toast, WhatsApp prefill URL captured via window.open shim). Google Maps iframe renders with correct src. All tel:/wa.me hrefs use 918247730083. Gallery filter switches image count (14 -> 4). Mobile viewport (390x844) has 0px horizontal overflow. JSON-LD in index.html includes Sunday in openingHoursSpecification.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='mobile-menu' element not present in DOM on mobile viewport. Hamburger toggle is not exposed with the documented testid, making mobile menu open/close automation impossible. Verify the drawer wraps its container with data-testid='mobile-menu'.

integration_issues.issue: Page <title> lags by one navigation step. After clicking nav-link-services (URL /services), title still reads the About page title; /models shows the Services title, etc. Likely a state/effect ordering issue in components/site/SEO.jsx (title being set from previous route). Meta description likely affected similarly.

action_items: Add data-testid='mobile-menu' to the mobile drawer/menu container in the navbar.
Fix SEO component so <title>/description update synchronously with the active route (title currently reflects the previous page after client-side navigation).
critical_code_review_comments: BookService.jsx: form uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via env - correct. Consider trimming/validating phone format before submit.
SEO.jsx suspected: title updates may be racing with route change (see integration issue).
index.html JSON-LD correctly lists all 7 days including Sunday with 09:00-23:00.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed bookings via backend tests and one via UI (TEST_UIRider). Persisted in MongoDB collection 'bookings'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sunday-OPEN fix is verified everywhere (no 'Closed' on site). Booking flow, Maps, hrefs, gallery filter, mobile overflow all OK. Two open items: (1) missing data-testid='mobile-menu'; (2) SEO title lags by one nav step. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_bullet_zone.py and the Playwright nav+title check after fixes.
rca of the issue: SEO title lag: SEO component likely calls document.title in an effect that runs after the previous page's SEO effect has already mounted; alternatively react-helmet or similar is not being flushed before Playwright's networkidle assertion. Suggest using useLayoutEffect or ensuring Helmet is properly mounted at the top-level router.
